key.name: autoconnect
key.description: Start the tunnel shortly after you sign in, using the settings below.

key.name: keepalive
key.description: Reconnect automatically when the tunnel drops, unless you disconnected it yourself.

key.name: notify-state
key.description: Show a banner whenever the tunnel goes up or down.

key.name: interface-name
key.description: Name of the virtual network device Pangolin creates.

key.name: upstream-dns
key.description: DNS server used for names outside the tunnel.

key.name: override-dns
key.summary: Resolve resource names through the tunnel
key.description: Use the tunnel's DNS to resolve internal resource names.

key.name: prefer-local-routes
key.description: When your local network and the tunnel can both reach an address, use the local one.

key.name: holepunch
key.description: Try a direct peer-to-peer connection before falling back to a relay.

key.name: mtu
key.description: Maximum packet size inside the tunnel. Leave at 1280 unless you know you need a different value.

key.name: log-level
key.description: How much detail the client logs: debug, info, warn or error.

key.name: match-domains
key.description: Only names matching these comma-separated patterns use the tunnel (e.g. *.proxy.internal). Leave empty to send all lookups through the tunnel.

key.name: check-updates-at-login
key.summary: Check for client updates at login
key.description: Once per session, compare the installed CLI with the latest release and notify when an update exists.

key.name: last-remote-version
key.description: Version reported by the most recent update check. Used by the preferences window.
